summary_rationale: General Dynamics combines an irreplaceable sole-source/duopoly U.S. nuclear submarine franchise ($220.3B record backlog, 6.8x Q3 2026 book-to-bill) and a high-margin Gulfstream ultra-long-range business jet franchise (14.5% Aerospace margin in Q3 2026) with disciplined capital allocation and 13.22% ROIC. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because Marine Systems operating margins (7.0% in FY2025, 7.9% in Q3 2026) remain below historical 9-10% norms due to supply-chain friction and labor ramp, G400 FAA certification has shifted into late-2026+, and CEO Phebe Novakovic is transitioning the CEO seat to Danny Deep after Q3 2026.
